dedupe_keys.name: fragility functions for reinforced concrete buildings in colombia national seismic risk model

description: This dataset gives the analyses behind seismic fragility functions for reinforced concrete wall buildings typical of Colombia, produced for the National Seismic Risk Model commissioned by the Colombian Geological Service. It was published on Zenodo on 8 October 2025 by Orlando Arroyo of the Universidad Industrial de Santander and Ricardo Bonett of the Universidad de Medellín, and is linked to an article in Earthquake Spectra. Each PDF file covers one building and reports its macro-parameters (period, wall index, wall aspect ratio and stiffness index) with pushover and nonlinear analysis results; file names indicate buildings in cities such as Medellín, Barranquilla, Bucaramanga, Pereira, Ibagué and Armenia and heights from 5 to 20 storeys. Coverage: reinforced concrete wall buildings across Colombian cities. Access: individual PDFs of about 2 MB each on Zenodo; the concept DOI groups versions. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: results are in PDF sheets, not machine-readable tables; the city and storey reading of file names is inferred. Simulation uses: vulnerability inputs for national and city earthquake loss models. Related records: the Global Earthquake Model resources and the Malawi seismic scenario case study.
